name: MAGS
desc: An artificial-intelligence store manager speaking through a ceiling speaker. Middle-aged male voice with a smooth American corporate-training-video tone, relentlessly upbeat and polite, perfectly even rhythm with a faint synthetic sheen, like a cheerful in-store announcement. Clear studio quality.
text: Welcome to Void Mart, where we are open until the heat death of the universe. Today only, every disaster is a sales opportunity. Have a stellar shift!
